scope: Borrow live SSA local roots during synchronous indexed reads; preserve ordinary named/captured loads and returned value ownership.

verification.semantic_coverage: jit_nested_paths runs interpreter, VM and JIT; covers returned snapshots, negative/fractional indexes, missing keys, scalar errors, named/captured paths and loop state.

limitations: Whole-function handle count, not elapsed-time speedup.

Initial test directly invoked loop compiler without satisfying runtime entry eligibility; corrected fixture exercises whole-function entry. The initial harness failure is not treated as a language defect.
All-50 release checksum, production and competitive acceptance remain open.
